SELECT
b_idx AS brnIdx,
b_name AS brnName,
b_address AS brnAddress,
b_description AS brnDescription,
b_latitude AS brnLatitude,
b_altitude AS brnLongitude,
b_phone AS brnPhone,
b_file AS brnFile,
b_active AS brnActive
FROM branch
WHERE b_active = 1

SELECT
b_idx AS brnIdx,
b_name AS brnName,
b_address AS brnAddress,
b_description AS brnDescription,
b_latitude AS brnLatitude,
b_altitude AS brnLongitude,
b_phone AS brnPhone,
b_file AS brnFile,
b_active AS brnActive
FROM branch
WHERE b_active = 1
AND b_latitude BETWEEN #{swLat} AND #{neLat}
AND b_altitude BETWEEN #{swLng} AND #{neLng}

SELECT
b_idx AS brnIdx,
b_name AS brnName,
b_address AS brnAddress,
b_description AS brnDescription,
b_latitude AS brnLatitude,
b_altitude AS brnLongitude,
b_phone AS brnPhone,
b_file AS brnFile,
b_active AS brnActive
FROM branch
WHERE b_idx = #{brnIdx}

SELECT
b_idx AS brnIdx,
b_name AS brnName,
b_address AS brnAddress,
b_description AS brnDescription,
b_latitude AS brnLatitude,
b_altitude AS brnLongitude,
b_phone AS brnPhone,
b_file AS brnFile,
b_active AS brnActive,
(6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(b_latitude))
* cos(radians(b_altitude) - radians(#{lng}))
+ sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(b_latitude)))) AS distance
FROM branch
WHERE b_active = 1
HAVING distance < 5
ORDER BY distance
